practical_works: Write a program to find the roots of an equation f(x) = 0 using various method.
Write a program to find the integral of a function using various method.
Write a program to solve the system of equations Ax = b in various algorithm.
Write a program to find the largest (or smallest) Eigen value and corresponding eigen vector of a square matrix using power (or inverse power) method.
Write a program to solve first and second order ordinary differential equations (initial value problem) using Runge-Kutta fourth order method.
Write a program to solve first and second order ordinary differential equations (initial value problem) using adaptive Runge-Kutta method.
references_verbatim: Veerarjan, T and Ramachandran, T. Numerical methods with programming in 'C', Second Edition, Tata McGraw-Hill Publishing Co. Ltd. (2007).
Rajasekaran S, 'Numerical Methods in Science and Engineering-A practical approach', AH wheeler & Co.
Grewal B.S., 'Numerical methods in Engineering and Science', Khanna Publications.
Sankara Rao K, Numerical Methods for Scientists and Engineers - 3rd edition, Prentice Hall of India Private Ltd, New Delhi, (2007).
Chopra, S. C and Canale, R. P. 'Numerical Methods for Engineers', 5th Edition, Tata McGraw-Hill, New Delhi, 2007.
